responsibility: This machine-description file contains NDS32-specific peephole and split optimizations applied after reload or during late RTL cleanup. It rewrites operand order to unlock shorter 16-bit encodings, merges paired scalar moves into movd44 or fcpysd forms, drops unused mod results from divmod expansions, and simplifies some doubleword and DSP multiply cases, serving as the late target-specific code-shaping layer distinct from the main instruction patterns.
